newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 ends above 3,900, within sight of record.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 ends above 3,900, within sight of record.

text.p: London's FTSE 100 index pushed back above 3,900 and to within sight of its all-time high on Monday, as inflation worries on both sides of the Atlantic eased, traders said.
Benign UK inflation data helped cheer sentiment in London as did a continuation of Friday's advance on Wall Street as interest rate jitters there faded, traders said.
The FTSE 100 index of leading stocks finished the session 17.8 points higher at 3,910.8, 7.9 points off its closing high and 11.3 points from its intraday peak, both set on August 28.
Advancers outnumbered decliners by more than two to one.
